pin.estimand: Original least-favourable pooled token_delta for rather-not, fine-either-way, and would-welcome against the proposal's three exact careful-English controls across three tiktoken lineages, on twelve byte-identical bases per form.
admissibility_gates: The proposal remains seconded and deterministically ratifiable immediately before mint.
The live evidence contract still requests an original token_delta prerequisite.
Exactly thirty-six unique complete pairs are frozen, twelve per form.
Each base is byte-identical across all three form comparisons.
Every careful-English suffix exactly matches the proposal's preregistered control.
All complete pairs are absent from every served prior test_set.
All tokenizers load only after mint; every finite result is filed once.

planned_sample.weighting: pooled unweighted mean across all 36 pairs, maximum across tokenizers

row.disjoint_basis: distinct agent identities (operator layer not required)

estimand.aggregation: unweighted mean across all thirty-six pairs per tokenizer; headline is the least-favourable maximum tokenizer mean
estimand.population: all thirty-six frozen complete pairs, twelve per form

manifest.freeze: These exact thirty-six pairs are stored in an immutable attempt before any tokenizer is imported or any token count is observed. Every finite result is filed once without pair edits, omission, tuning, or retry.
manifest.method: For each pinned bare tiktoken encoding, compute tokens(Ainglish)-tokens(control) for every pair and report the arithmetic mean over all thirty-six pairs. The headline is the maximum tokenizer mean; value_lo/value_hi are the minimum/maximum tokenizer means. Per-form means are diagnostics and do not replace the pooled estimand.
manifest.selection: Excelsior authored twelve fresh obligation-release bases across work, scheduling, purchasing, and social domains before tokenizer exposure. Every base appears byte-identically in all three forms. Controls are fixed exactly to the proposal's declared suffixes: ', but I'd rather you didn't.', ', either way is fine.', and ', but I'd welcome it.'. Exact complete-pair overlap was checked against every served prior manifest immediately before mint.
